meta.name: elevenlabs-dialogue
meta.description: ElevenLabs multi-speaker dialogue generation - create conversations with different voices in a single audio file via inference.sh CLI. Capabilities: multi-voice dialogue, script-based generation, voice direction, conversation audio. Use for: podcasts, audiobooks, explainers, tutorials, character dialogue, video scripts. Triggers: elevenlabs dialogue, eleven labs dialogue, multi speaker, conversation audio, dialogue generation, text to dialogue, multi voice, voice acting, podcast dialogue, character voices, script to audio, elevenlabs conversation, two speakers

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用不同声音生成多角色对话音频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用不同声音生成多角色对话音频
copy.tagline_en: Generate multi-speaker dialogue audio with different voices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create multi-voice dialogue audio for podcasts, audiobooks, or videos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行生成多角色对话音频。你提供脚本和角色，它会用不同声音合成对话，并输出一个音频文件。
howto.when: 当你提到“elevenlabs dialogue”、“多角色对话”、“对话生成”等关键词，或要求制作播客、有声书、教程等对话音频时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一段采访对话，用 George 和 Aria 的声音。
say.note: 会调用 CLI 生成对话音频。

say.text: 用 Daniel 和 Jessica 的声音做一个教程对话，包含步骤说明。
say.note: 会生成教学场景的对话音频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate multi-speaker dialogue audio via command line. You provide a script with roles, and it synthesizes the conversation using different voices, outputting a single audio file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'elevenlabs dialogue', 'multi-speaker', 'dialogue generation', or request podcast, audiobook, tutorial, etc., dialogue audio.

say_en.text: Generate an interview dialogue using George and Aria voices.
say_en.note: Triggers CLI to produce dialogue audio.

say_en.text: Create a tutorial dialogue with Daniel and Jessica, including step-by-step instructions.
